name: Musinsa Beauty
what: Big beauty store with a wide niche perfume wall (Korean and international).

name: Seongsu-dong and Hannam-dong
what: Neighbourhoods with flagship stores: Postes, Kinfolk Notes, Tamburins, SW19, Nonfiction, Granhand.

name: Shilla Duty Free (online)
what: Duty-free online shop carrying many Korean niche lines.

name: CentralWorld, ICONSIAM, Central Ladprao
what: Malls with BOROM counters and other Thai houses.

name: Beautrium
what: Thai beauty chain with exclusive budget perfumes and Gulf brands like Ajmal.

name: Karmakamet Scentorium (Erawan Bangkok)
what: Free scent museum with hundreds of smells; book ahead.

name: Nose Shop
what: The best place to find Japanese indie perfumers.

what: Drugstore with affordable hair and body mists like Milky Mane.

what: Canadian shops selling Korean mists and hair perfumes in CAD.

what: Old attar and oil shops next to modern perfumers like Sifr Aromatics.

name: 30ml, H Parfums, La Maison Générale
what: Niche shops carrying Montreal indies like Universal Flowering and Miskeo.

name: Le Marais and Palais-Royal
what: Serge Lutens, Buly 1803, État Libre d'Orange and many niche boutiques within walking distance.

name: Officina di Santa Maria Novella, Via della Scala
what: The historic monastery pharmacy, open to visitors.

name: Covent Garden and Burlington Arcade
what: Floral Street, Penhaligon's, Miller Harris and more.
